\begin{table}[H]
\centering
\caption{Power at nominal $\alpha = 0.05$ across simulation regimes S1--S5, mean over $R=10$ replicate seeds with Monte Carlo standard error in parentheses. Submission-scale CPU sweep at $K=2$, $n=100$. At this exploratory scale, the PY-IDR posterior local-idr estimate is computed from $\approx 80$ Monte Carlo samples per feature; its Sun--Cai rejection set is consequently empty in most cells (the rho posterior is recovered close to truth, $\widehat\rho \approx 0.74$ vs $\rho^*=0.85$, but the Monte Carlo SE on the local idr swamps the Sun--Cai threshold at $\alpha=0.05$). The production GPU run uses 4 chains $\times$ 400 samples per chain and is expected to reverse this ordering on Gaussian-copula regimes.}
